market_outlook.short_term: Volatile but stabilizing. Fed hike digested (Dow -700 intraday, recovered). Oil weakness supports risk appetite. Key risk: Warsh hawkish tone signals potential follow-on hikes. Crypto tax bill passage provides regulatory clarity but $50B crash lingers. ASX rebound signals global risk-on. Expect 5-8% equity volatility over next 30 days.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive with caveats. AI capex cycle (data centers, quantum, India enablers) provides 2-3 year structural tailwind. However, Gundlach's fiscal crisis warning and consumer selectivity suggest a slower, more selective recovery. Fed tightening may cap multiple expansion. Favor quality, cash-generative names over speculative growth. 6-12 month equity return: 4-7% with high dispersion.
